phases.name: Foundation & Mobility
phases.focus: Rebuild movement quality, core control and joint mobility while introducing light loading.

phases.name: Strength Development
phases.focus: Progress multi-joint strength with controlled loading, prioritising safe spine mechanics and increased intensity.

phases.name: Strength Consolidation & Capacity
phases.focus: Increase work capacity and consolidate strength gains with higher density and planned progression, preparing for long-term maintenance.

non_negotiables: Follow physio guidance regarding L4-L5 disc herniation
Use neutral spine positions for all lifts
Prioritise controlled tempo and bracing over maximal loads
Include progressive warm-up before every session
Stop and reassess if any radicular pain or return of symptoms

stage2.text:
PLAN "12-week Post-Herniated Disc Safe Strength Program"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary rehabilitation:
    name "Restore safe strength and capacity after L4-L5 disc herniation while avoiding heavy spinal loading"
PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation & Mobility" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Upper_Strength training 50m "Upper Strength":
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
          arm_circles 2m
          band_pull_aparts 2m
        main straight_sets:
          seated_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
          shoulder_stretch 3m
      DAY Lower_Strength_low_spinal_load training 55m "Lower Strength (low spinal load)":
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
          leg_swings 2m
          hip_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 4m
          quad_stretch 4m
      DAY Mobility_Core_Conditioning training 45m "Mobility & Core / Conditioning":
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
          cat_cow 3m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x20s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          sled_push 6x20m rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          rowing 8m rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 4m
          hip_flexor_stretch 3m
      DAY Full_Body_Hypertrophy_controlled_loading training 60m "Full-Body Hypertrophy (controlled loading)":
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
          inchworm 2m
          ankle_rolls 2m
        main straight_sets:

          step_up 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
